title: Full cochain-unit normalization from K-injective normalization
statement:
Let $A,B,C,D$ be abelian categories with derived categories, and assume that $A$ has K-injective resolutions. Let $F:A\to B$ and $G:C\to D$ be additive, $U:A\to C$ and $V:B\to D$ exact additive, and $o:FV\simeq UG$. Use the canonical total right derived functor of $F$ [lem-diagonal-canonical-right-derived], a specified total right derived functor $R_G$ with cochain unit $\eta_G$ [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit], and an isomorphism $e:R_FD(V)\simeq D(U)R_G$. Write $c_U,c_V$ for the exact-functor localization comparisons. Suppose that for every K-injective complex $I$, the arrow $\eta_G(U I)$ is invertible and
\[e_{QI}\,R_G(c_U(I))=D(V)(\kappa_F(I))\,c_V(FI)\,Q(o_I)\,\eta_G(UI),\]
where $\kappa_F(I):R_F(QI)\simeq Q(FI)$ is the canonical computation isomorphism. Then for every complex $P$,
\[D(V)(\eta_F(P))\,e_{QP}\,R_G(c_U(P))=c_V(FP)\,Q(o_P)\,\eta_G(UP).\]
All compositions are in application order.

On K-injective complexes, the canonical cochain unit is the inverse of the computation isomorphism. Cancel it in the constructed normalization and use the supplied varying normalization to identify their isomorphisms.

Every derived object is isomorphic to a K-injective complex. Naturality and cancellation show that the two comparison natural transformations agree everywhere. Substitution yields the full normalization.

theorem diagonalTrace_full_normalization_of_kInjective
    {A B C D : Type a} [Category.{v} A] [Category.{v} B]
    [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v} D] [Abelian A] [Abelian B] [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wc} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{wc} D]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions A]
    (F : A ⥤ B) (G : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (U : A ⥤ C) (V : B ⥤ D) [U.Additive] [V.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits U] [PreservesFiniteColimits U]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits V] [PreservesFiniteColimits V]
    (RG : DiagonalRightDerived G) (ordinary : F ⋙ V ≅ U ⋙ G)
    (e : F.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ V.mapDerivedCategory ≅ U.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RG.R)
    (hacyc : ∀ (I : CochainComplex A ℤ), I.IsKInjective →
      IsIso (RG.η.app ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)))
    (hk : ∀ (I : CochainComplex A ℤ) (hI : I.IsKInjective),
      letI := hI
      e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≫
          RG.R.map (U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app I) =
        V.mapDerivedCategory.map (F.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso I).hom ≫
          V.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map
            ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex ordinary.hom (.up ℤ)).app I) ≫
          RG.η.app ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I))
    (P : CochainComplex A ℤ) :
    V.mapDerivedCategory.map (F.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ P) ≫
        e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        RG.R.map (U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) =
      V.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex ordinary.hom (.up ℤ)).app P) ≫
        RG.η.app ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
